info.title: Learnova Backend
info.description: Backend API for Learnova learner and instructor workflows.

get.description: A simple root endpoint helps confirm that the backend process is up.
This is the app-level health check and does not depend on the database.
This route confirms that PostgreSQL is reachable from the backend layer.

post.description: This creates a local user account and returns a bearer token for the new session.
This authenticates an existing local user against the PostgreSQL users table.
This verifies a Google credential on the backend and returns a Learnova session token.

get.description: This validates whether an account already exists for the supplied email.
This returns the user identity embedded in the current bearer token.
This returns the learner dashboard payload for the authenticated user.

post.description: This enrolls the current learner in a free self-enrollable course.

get.description: This returns the learner-facing detail payload for one course.
This returns the review payload for one course.

post.description: This creates or updates the current learner review for the target course.
This creates a Razorpay order for a paid course enrollment.
This verifies the Razorpay signature and marks the course enrollment as paid.

get.description: This returns a single content item payload for direct lesson-player loading.

post.description: This updates lesson/document/video progress for the current learner.

get.description: This returns the quiz payload for the requested course content slug.

post.description: This scores and stores a learner quiz attempt.

get.description: This returns reporting summary cards and course-wise learner progress rows.
This returns admin/instructor user records for responsible-user dropdowns.

post.description: This stores a local uploaded asset and returns its served URL.

get.description: This returns the instructor/admin course list for backoffice views.

post.description: This creates a new course record and attaches its initial tags.

get.description: This returns one course record for the instructor course form.

put.description: This updates the editable course fields and course tags.

delete.description: This deletes a course and its dependent rows through database cascades.

post.description: This toggles the publish state used by the website/app visibility flow.

get.description: This returns the attendee list for the selected course.

post.description: This adds or updates attendee enrollments and supports invitation/admin-added flows.

get.description: This returns the ordered course content list for the instructor content tab.

post.description: This creates a lesson/content item for the selected course.

get.description: This returns one content record for the content editor.

put.description: This updates an existing lesson/content item.

get.description: This returns the quiz list for the selected course.

post.description: This creates a quiz content item and its builder data.

get.description: This returns one quiz payload for the quiz builder.

put.description: This updates quiz questions, options, rewards, and course-content metadata.

delete.description: This deletes a quiz and its linked quiz-type content record.
